name: _burn.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_burn.scss — the hover title combustion: burning-ink state on
//  the overlay h2, the canvas overlay that owns the rasterized glyphs while
//  they erode, and the rewrite slot inserted above the description (hidden
//  spacer dup + the <draw-text> clone that rewrites the title).
//  Imported by home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// While the canvas owns the title's pixels the DOM glyphs stay mounted for
// layout/a11y but paint nothing — the displaced/burning texture IS the text.
.home-mosaic-title--burning {
  color: transparent;
  text-shadow: none;
}

// Combustion canvas — absolutely positioned over the title box by JS
// (inline left/top/width/height); never intercepts the card link's pointer.
.home-mosaic-title-burn {
  position: absolute;
  display: block;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 2;
}

// Rewrite slot above the description — the spacer dup holds the space the
// animated clone occupies, so the panel never reflows as chars draw in.
.home-mosaic-title-slot {
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-2xs);
}

// Invisible spacer — same typography as the title so its box IS the slot.
.home-mosaic-title-dup {
  @extend %TTL_SM;
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  visibility: hidden;
  font-size: var(--space-md); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16
  font-size: clamp(var(--space-md), 5cqw, var(--space-lg));
}

// The rewritten title overlays the spacer exactly.
.home-mosaic-title-rewrite {
  @extend %TTL_SM;
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  display: block;
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 100;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  font-size: var(--space-md); // fallback: Safari < 16 / iOS < 16
  font-size: clamp(var(--space-md), 5cqw, var(--space-lg));

  // Char draw at the desc cadence — rewritten as the burn completes.
  .draw-text__char {
    animation: char-draw 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
    animation-delay: calc(var(--offset, 0ms) + var(--i, 0) * var(--char-delay, 8ms));
  }
}
